description: WP-G4 Codex: Adeptus Custodes (11e) ADVANCED FIREPOWER (Caladius Annihilator): ranged attacks that target a MONSTER/VEHICLE can re-roll one hit, one wound and one damage roll. Fixture cus11e_g4_shoot (tests/helpers/gen_codex11e_g4_fixtures.gd; P1 Custodes' Shooting phase). A real token click selects the Annihilator; its Arachnus blaze carronade is assigned to the Ork Deff Dread with the actions the shooting panel sends. The staged dock offers the free re-roll as 'ADVANCED FIREPOWER (free)' at the hit pause and again at the wound pause; real clicks on the failed die chips re-roll them with no CP, the grant is spent once per roll type and the Game Log names each re-roll. Setup privileges: auto wound allocation; both players 0 CP; the Deff Dread's wounds inflated.

steps.script:
SettingsService.set("auto_allocate_wounds", true)
GameState.state.players["1"]["cp"] = 0
GameState.state.players["2"]["cp"] = 0
for m in GameState.state.units["U_DEFF_DREAD_A"].models:
	m["wounds"] = 99
	m["current_wounds"] = 99
return true
steps.comment: setup privileges: auto wound allocation; both players 0 CP (no stratagem competes); the Deff Dread's wounds inflated so it survives
